description_en: Enables zone fault degradation for a scaling group
description_zh: 开启伸缩组可用区故障降级
name: StartScalingGroupZoneShift

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。 从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the impaired zones. Valid values of N: 1 to 5
parameters.help_zh: 受损的可用区 ID 列表。 N 的取值范围：1~5
parameters.name: impaired_zone_ids

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the zone transfer. After the time expires, the system automatically ends the transfer and restores the related zones. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The value must be later than the current time and cannot be more than 3 days from the current time
parameters.help_zh: 可用区转移的到期时间，到期后系统自动结束本次转移并恢复相关可用区。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。 格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。 取值须晚于当前时间，且不超过当前时间起 3 天
parameters.name: expiry_time
